scene.name: papers/c6_banana_swing

task.name: papers
task.sentence: Take the banana off the swinging cord and hold it in a gripper for a second.
task.protocol: One banana that keeps swinging on its cord (a motor at the pivot restores the swing after a knock) until it is taken or falls, within the scene's 300 s cap.
task.pass_rule: Passed when the banana is off the cord and held in a gripper for 1 s.

scene.description: Sprout stands in a back garden in front of a banana that hangs from a long cord tied to a tree's branch and swings from side to side across its front; take the banana off the cord and hold it. No aid -- the head camera only.
